'''Bloodgouge''' was a fearsome [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Southern Jundland Wastes]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==History==
{{Quote|What do you say? Up for butchering some Sand People, throwing yourself against the forces of their most legendary leader?|[[Dorrick]], to an Imperial operative|<ref name="TOR:BaS">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Blood and Sand|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
Bloodgouge was engaged in a active war with the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] at [[Outpost Rennar]], in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]]. [[Gezda]] would remark that Bloodgouge and his tribe had killed more Mandalorians than anyone else on Tatooine.<ref name="TOR:BaS" />

Around this [[Time/Legends|time]], the chieftain's herald was provoked by the Imperial forces' destruction of his Herald's Totem beside his hut during the intruding party's search for a Tusken-distilled lethal poison's antidote, which was held within the shrine by the chieftain's cave, and was lured out to be likewise brought down before the cliff that sported Bloodgouge's cave. The Herald of Bloodgouge's mask was claimed as a trophy, and his demise brought the Tusken Raider clan to disarray.<ref name="TotC">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Test of the Clan|Tatooine}}</ref>

Bloodgouge would be [[Death/Legends|killed]] however in his [[Bloodgouge's Lair|cave]], next to which laid one of the Raiders' camp's holiest shrines, by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] strike team,<ref name="TOR:AJC" /> while Imperial forces had begun marshaling his people for an attack on Outpost Rennar.<ref name="TOR:BaS" />
